input.text: The driver is safe but still unwell, and cannot yet say if they are fit to drive. They will give a final yes or no before their train leaves at 13:25 today, and will only board it if fit.
The driver's travel is booked: train Aalborg → Copenhagen 21 Oct 13:25–17:45, flight Copenhagen → Hamburg 21 Oct 19:45–21:00, and a hotel for that night. Boarding is not confirmed.
Pickup slot is 22 Oct 11:00–14:00 (10:00–13:00 Hamburg time). The customer's delivery promise is 23 Oct 12:00–17:00 (11:00–16:00 Odense time). Both pickup and delivery contacts are still unconfirmed.

The only other flight quoted (Copenhagen → Hamburg 22 Oct 09:00–10:15, €142) is not booked and arrives too late for the pickup slot once you add the transfer. If the driver does not travel today, a replacement driver close to Hamburg is the realistic way to keep the slot.
An earlier proposal to prepare a backup driver, without cancelling the current driver, was approved but has not been carried out. No backup driver is on the order yet.
